translationRepairs: During Zhenjun, Minister of Works Cui Hao devised a calendar using the Five Yin as origin; before it could be adopted, Hao was executed and the project was abandoned.
During Zhenjun, Minister over the Masses Cui Hao devised a calendar using the Five Yin as origin; before it could be adopted, Hao was executed and the project was abandoned.
司徒 is Situ (Minister over the Masses / Excellency over the Masses), not Minister of Works (司空).
In the Zhenjun era, Minister of Works Cui Hao devised a calendar with the Five Yin as origin; before it could be implemented, Hao was executed and the project was abandoned.
In the Zhenjun era, Minister over the Masses Cui Hao devised a calendar with the Five Yin as origin; before it could be implemented, Hao was executed and the project was abandoned.
司徒 is Situ, not Minister of Works (司空).

In Wei, Du Kui mastered music and set pitch standards; Jin's Xun Xu used Du Kui's pipes to tune the eight sounds and concluded that from Later Han through Wei the standard foot ran more than four tenths longer than the ancient foot.

In Wei, Du Kui mastered music and set pitch standards; Jin Director of the Secretariat Xun Xu used Du Kui's pipes to tune the eight sounds and concluded that from Later Han through Wei the standard foot ran more than four tenths longer than the ancient foot.
English fuses office and name as "Jin's Xun Xu"; Chinese has 晉中書監荀勗—render the office clearly as in the literal field.

Soon Director of Ceremonies Liu Fang was ordered to revise music, defining one fen as the width of a single medium black millet grain; Commandant of the Guards Yuan Kuang, by contrast, used one grain's width to span two grain-gaps and thus obtain one fen.

Soon Director of Ceremonies Liu Fang was ordered to revise music, defining one fen as the width of a single medium black millet grain; while Commandant of the Guards Yuan Kuang took the width of one grain to span two gaps between grains and thus obtain one fen.
Tighten parallel with Chinese 而 and match literal's clearer "gaps between grains" for 度黍二縫.
Emperor Shizu, responding to his age, pacified the realm and ordered the late Minister of Works, Duke of Dongjun Cui Hao, to rework the calendrical calculations.
Emperor Shizu, responding to his age, pacified the realm and ordered the late Minister over the Masses, Duke of Dongjun Cui Hao, to rework the calendrical calculations.
司徒 is Situ (Minister over the Masses), not Minister of Works (司空).
Shizu responded to the age, pacified all Xia, and ordered the late Minister of Works, Duke of Dongjun Cui Hao, to weave together the numbers.
Shizu responded to the age, pacified all Xia, and ordered the late Minister over the Masses, Duke of Dongjun Cui Hao, to weave together the numbers.
司徒 is Situ, not Minister of Works.
In Jingming, Emperor Shizong ordered Gongsun Chong, Zhao Fansheng, and others jointly to examine and verify the calendar.

Chinese names both as 太樂令 and does not specify calendar; EN invented “the calendar” and dropped the second office title.

A careful review shows that the calendars previously submitted by Hong and his three colleagues, together with those of Commander of Horse Lu Daoqian; former Supreme Ultimate talent-selection army master Wei Hongxian; Director of Astronomy and General Who Exterminates Bandits Hu Rong; the monk leader Daorong of Yongzhou; Fan Zhongzun of Henan in Sizhou; and Zhang Sengyu of Julu in Dingzhou—in all nine parties—were combined into one calendar with the origin at renzi and pitch standards beginning at the Yellow Bell; comparing antiquity with the present, we judge it the most precise.

A careful review shows that the calendars previously submitted by Hong and the other two of the three parties, together with those of Commander of Horse Lu Daoqian; former Supreme Ultimate talent-selection army master Wei Hongxian; Director of Astronomy and General Who Exterminates Bandits Hu Rong; the monk leader Daorong of Yongzhou; Fan Zhongzun of Henan in Sizhou; and Zhang Sengyu of Julu in Dingzhou—in all nine parties—were combined into one calendar with the origin at renzi and pitch standards beginning at the Yellow Bell; comparing antiquity with the present, we judge it the most precise.
洪等三人 means the three men (Hong, Longxiang, Yexing), not Hong plus three colleagues.

Leaving the winter of the fourth year of Yanbi: Major General of the Central Fortitude and Commandant of Mounted Escort Zhang Hong; Longxiang, General Who Quells Bandits and son of the former Director of Astronomy Zhang Mingyu; and Proofreader Li Yexing—the three houses together submitted new calendars, each seeking adoption.
